meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 触发 GitHub Actions 的 publish 工作流,把 oh-my-opencode 及相关包发到 npm,并逐项核实:GitHub release 已创建、npm 版本已更新、Discord 公告已发。它只负责发布,不重跑代码评审。
howto.when: 当你要求发布(提到「publish」、「release」等关键词)并给出 patch、minor 等版本选择,或一个明确语义版本号时接管;没给版本选择会先停下询问。

say.text: 用 patch 发布这个版本
say.note: 触发发布工作流并跑完后续验证

say.text: 发布 minor,记得发 Discord 公告
say.note: 草拟发行说明并投递到 Discord

say.text: 按 5.0.0-beta.9 这个版本号发布
say.note: 用明确语义版本号派发工作流

howto.what_en: Triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow to ship oh-my-opencode and related packages to npm, then verifies the GitHub release, npm versions, and the Discord announcement. Ship-only: it does not re-run code review.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you ask to publish or release and give a version selector such as patch, minor, major, or an explicit semver. With no selector it stops and asks first.

say_en.text: Publish this with a patch bump
say_en.note: Triggers the publish workflow and its verifications

say_en.text: Do a minor release and post the Discord announcement
say_en.note: Drafts release notes and posts to Discord
Dispatches the workflow with an explicit version
